messages:
Rhea S: FinNimbus wants final capacity + pricing for a 12mo commit. Their peak says ~6k requests/minute for chat during business hours, baseline ~2k/min, and embedding batches that hit ~12k/min for short 5-10m windows. SLA ask: p99 chat <200ms. They also returned a security questionnaire asking about VPC peering, customer KMS, audit logs retention. Need engineering presales recommendation on reserved GPUs and autoscale policy.
Jon F: Clarify: 6k/min = 100 RPS peak; embedding bursts 200 RPS for 10m. What model choices?
Rhea S: Chat -> redwood-2-7b (q4_0 preferred); embeddings -> embed-lite.
Carmen L: Based on our benchmarks: redwood-2-7b at avg 320 tokens/session (256 in + 64 out) runs ~130 RPS per A100-80GB equiv when q4_0 with batching and KV caching enabled. Embeds ~1200/min per GPU.
Theo M: Back-of-envelope: baseline chat (100 RPS) ~1 GPU, peak chat spike to 200 RPS -> add 1 GPU. Embedding burst windows need separate pool: recommend 1 reserved embed GPU plus burst pool.
Jon F: Proposal for commit: reserve 2 chat GPUs (baseline + headroom) and 1 embed GPU. Provide burst credits / autoscale to allow up to +3 GPUs temporarily. That gives deterministic committed cost and room for spikes.
Carmen L: Add KV caching + scheduled preheat for known batch windows to cut compute by ~25%. Recommend 5-10 minute preheat for embed batches.
Rhea S: Autoscale policy draft?
Theo M: Example snippet we send customers:
```
metric: chat_rps
scale_up: threshold: 140 add: 1 cooldown: 60
scale_down: threshold: 80 remove: 1 cooldown: 120
max_replicas: 5
```
Theo M: Tune scale_up around 140-160 depending on observed p95 latency slope.
Jon F: Pricing idea: committed price covers 2 chat GPUs + 1 embed GPU at ~30% discount vs on-demand. Bursts consume 'burst credits' (metered) or pay overage at on-demand rate. Include overage kicker in contract.
Rhea S: Security Qs: they require KMS + VPC + audit logs. Can we provide KMS & VPC peering on hosted + Private options?
Presales Bot: SOC2 report: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2.pdf
Presales Bot: VPC peering guide: https://redwood.example.com/private/vpc-peering

Carmen L: For Private deployments we can offer customer-managed KMS and per-tenant audit retention as a paid option. Mention as negotiation lever.
Jon F: They asked for a 3-day POC next Tuesday to validate latency and cost. Recommend two lanes: 1) chat steady + controlled spikes to validate autoscale and p99; 2) batch embed lane to validate preheat and batch throughput. SRE needs a slot for monitoring.
Rhea S: Who will own the security questionnaire and capacity runbook?
Jon F: I'll take the security questionnaire (KMS/VPC/audit). Theo — can you draft the capacity runbook and POC test plan (traffic curves, expected metrics, autoscale thresholds)?
Theo M: Yes. I'll attach synthetic load profiles and the autoscale config in the runbook.
Rhea S: Perfect. Please post questionnaire answers and pricing draft here by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
